leadText:
Tyra (Japanese: ミサ Misa) is a character of the day who appeared in The Bridge Bike Gang. She is a member of a gang who have claimed Cycling Road as their territory. They battle s who are traveling across the bridge.

She and Chopper, another member of the gang, are old friends of Jessie and James, as they were once part of the bike gang.

Tyra battled with her . Tyra seemed to have the upper hand, but because of 's disturbance, the battle was undecided. Tyra recognized Jessie as "Big Jess". She and the rest of the gang were ultimately scared away by the police; however, upon convincing Jessie, James, and to ride in the storm, she returned to the cycling road. There, she and the other members helped deliver the medicine to the sick in Sunnytown.

==Trivia==
In Pocket Monsters Film Comic Volume 10, this character is referred to as 「ミカ」 Mika in the character profile. However, in the chapter itself, she is referred to as 「ミサ」 Misa, like in the original episode.
Her name is a pun on "tire", a reference to her being part of a bike gang.
